visual_goal: Show stressor analysis as a left-to-right workshop flow with a loop back: list stressors, record attractors, see what breaks, name residues, count them, test with a combined stressor, then either loop back or invest.
prompt: A simple left-to-right flow of five rounded cards in one straight row, joined by exactly four short straight blue arrows between neighbors (one arrow between each pair, nothing else between the cards). Cards, left to right: a stack of sticky notes labeled 'Stressors'; a cracked gear labeled 'What breaks'; a sturdy brick labeled 'Residue'; two lightning bolts striking together labeled 'Combined stressor'; a rising bar chart labeled 'Invest'. The arrow from 'Combined stressor' to 'Invest' is green. Above the row, exactly one curved orange arrow arches from the top of 'Combined stressor' back to the top of 'Residue', labeled 'new residue'. No currency symbols. These six labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A flow from stressors to what breaks to residue to a combined stressor and then invest; an orange arrow loops from the combined stressor back to residue when a new residue is needed.

visual_goal: Show many unrelated stressors on the left converging on a few residues on the right, with the vehicle key receiving the most arrows.
prompt: A left-to-right convergence illustration with no crossing lines. On the right, a vertical column of four sturdy blue foundation blocks, top to bottom: a large tall block 'Vehicle key', then 'Provenance', then 'License and purpose', then 'Adapters'. On the left, a vertical column of seven small orange storm-cloud tiles, top to bottom: 'Register outage', 'Acquisition', 'Privacy ruling', 'EV price fall', 'Supplier error', 'Connected-car data', 'DMS attack'. Exactly seven straight, non-crossing arrows, each cloud sending one arrow: the top three clouds 'Register outage', 'Acquisition' and 'Privacy ruling' all point into 'Vehicle key'; 'EV price fall' and 'Supplier error' both point into 'Provenance'; 'Connected-car data' points into 'License and purpose'; 'DMS attack' points into 'Adapters'. The 'Vehicle key' block is visibly the largest. These eleven labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Seven stressors on the left send arrows to four residues: register outage, acquisition and privacy ruling to the vehicle key; EV price fall and supplier error to provenance; connected-car data to license and purpose; DMS attack to adapters.

visual_goal: Show the Year 1, Year 3 and Year 5 horizons as three plateaus separated by gates, with a yearly stressor review feeding all three.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration of three rising plateaus like steps of a landscape. Left plateau labeled 'Year 1' with a single folder icon. Middle plateau labeled 'Year 3' with a small lightning-bolt event icon. Right plateau labeled 'Year 5' with a small helper robot beside a car. Between 'Year 1' and 'Year 3' stands a closed gate barrier labeled 'gate'. Between 'Year 3' and 'Year 5' stands a second gate barrier labeled 'gate'. One arrow passes through each gate, left to right. Below all three plateaus, a long teal band labeled 'Stressor review each year' with three short upward arrows, one into each plateau. These six labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Three rising plateaus labeled Year 1, Year 3 and Year 5 separated by two gates, with a yearly stressor review band beneath feeding all three.
